thread:
Alex: opened a docs PR to standardize tracing config keys across console examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1287 — main change is rename trace.sampling -> trace.sampler. can owners sanity-check crosslinks and any redirects?

Morgan: thanks — quick q: runtime still accepts the old key right? need a migration note for users.

Alex: yes runtime accepts both for graceful rollout, but we should show the new key as canonical. planning to add a short migration snippet and a compatibility note. example YAML snippet i added:```yaml
route: default
tracing:
  sampler:
    type: head_percent
    value: 10
```

Taylor: i can pick up the Node + Go SDK snippets. will mirror the key rename in both. tagging @Jamie for the dashboard screenshot that references the metric name. also will run the snippet smoke tests.

Jamie: will update the dashboard image — note we also changed the metric label from latency -> latency_p50_ms in the telemetry rename last week, so screenshots + alt text need adjustment.

Alex: docs-bot ran the linter earlier: docs-bot: lint found 2 broken links in console/examples (console/traces -> console/tracehook-old). CI/links: https://ci.internal/links/5492

Morgan: i can take the link redirects. i'll add 301s in the netlify redirect map and a note in the migration doc. also will add a short paragraph on KV-prefetch cost attribution (customers keep asking why prefetch shows in cost breakdown).

Taylor: small test plan: add tests/snippet-smoke.js that renders the example with the tracing key and asserts no lint errors and that YAML frontmatter includes 'tracing:'. i'll open a tiny follow-up PR if that's ok.

Alex: SGTM. PR is WIP but contains the content changes + Node/Python examples. PTAL @Morgan @Taylor @Jamie. if no blockers i'll merge after owner approvals and linkcheck passes.

Jamie: nit: in the dashboard image update, change the alt text to 'Dashboard — latency (p50) by route' for accessibility.

Morgan: :thumbsup: pushing redirect fix in a sec. will also sweep for any remaining "trace.sampling" occurrences.

Alex: thanks all. i'll add a short release note in the PR description explaining the compatibility window and the reason for the key rename (align with tracing-hook v2).

docs-bot: deploy-preview created for PR#1287 at https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/1287 — running linkcheck + screenshot diff. will post results here when done.

Taylor: cool — once linkcheck green i'll merge the tests follow-up into main, then we can tag the docs release.

Alex: closing loop — if anyone spots more orphan links run `scripts/link-checker --path console` locally and push fixes. cheers.
